m: 1. शप् (in gram.) a technical term used for the Vikaraṇa a (inserted between the root and terminations of the conjugational tenses in verbs of the 1st class; see वि-करण, p. 954).
2. शप् ind. a prefix implying assent or acceptance (as in शप्-करोति, he admits or accepts), W.

3. शप् cl. 1. 4. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 31; xxvi, 59) शपति, ˚ते or शप्यति, ˚ते (the latter only in Bhaṭṭ.; pf. शशाप, शेपे aor. अशाप्सीत्, अशप्त Gr. [2. pl. शाप्त in TS. prob. w.r.]; fut. शप्ता, ib.; शप्स्यति, ˚ते, ib.; शपिष्ये, MBh.; inf. शप्तुम् or शपितुम्, ib.; ind.p. शपित्वा, ib.; शप्त्वा Gr.), to curse (mostly P. with acc.; in AV. v, 30, 3 Ā. with dat.), RV. &c. &c.; (P. Ā.) to swear an oath, utter an execration (sometimes with शपथम् or ˚थान्; also with अनृतम्, to swear a false oath), RV. &c. &c.; (P. Ā.) to revile, scold, blame (acc., rarely dat.), Yājñ.; Kāv.; Pur.; (Ā.; mc. also P.) to curse one's self (followed by यदि, ‘if’, i.e. to promise with an oath, vow or swear, ‘that one will not’ &c.; or followed by dat. and rarely acc. of the person to whom and instr. of the object by which one swears; or followed by इति, e.g. वरुणेति, ‘to swear by the name of Varuṇa’, VS.), RV. &c. &c.; (Ā.) to adjure, supplicate, conjure any one (acc.) by (instr.), R.; Hariv. : Caus. शापयति (aor. अशीशपत्), to adjure, conjure, exorcise (demons), AV.; AitBr.; to cause any one (acc.) to swear by (instr.), Mn. viii, 113 (cf. शापित) : Desid. शिशप्सति, ˚ते Gr.: Intens. शाशप्यते, शाशप्ति, or शंशप्यते, शंशप्ति, ib.
a: शप् — A technical term used by Pāṇini for the conjugational sign अ inserted between the root and the terminations of the conjugational tenses in the first class of roots.
शप् — ind. A particle and prefix implying assent or compliance.

शप् — {c1c} {c4c} U. (शपति-ते, शप्यति-ते, शप्त) 1 To curse, execrate; अशपद्भव मानुषीति तां R. 8. 80; सोऽभूत्परासुरथ भूमिपतिं शशाप (वृद्धः) 9. 78, 1. 77. --2 To swear, take an oath, promise by oath, say on oath, (usually with dat. of the person to whom a promise &c. is made and instr. of the object by which it is made); भरतेनात्पना चाहं शपे ते मनुजाधिप . यथा नान्येन तुष्येयमृते रामविवासनात् Rām; when used without an object it generally governs the instr. of the thing and dat. of the person by which or whom the oath is taken; सत्यं शपामि ने पादपंकजस्पर्शेन K.; Ghaṭ. 22; अशप्त निह्नुवानाऽसौ सीतायै स्मरमोहितः Bk. 8. 74; प्रेम जिज्ञासमानाब्यस्ताब्योऽशप्सत कामिनः 8. 33; sometimes शप् governs a cognate accusative सहत्रशोऽसौ शपथानशप्यत् Bk. 3. 32. --3 To blame, scold, revile, abuse (with dat or by itself); द्विषद्भ्यश्चाशपस्तया Bk. 17. 4. प्रतिवाचमदत्त केशवः शपमानाय न चेदिभूभुजे Śi. 16 25. --Caus. (शापयति-ते) To bind by an oath, conjure; शापितोऽसि गोब्राह्मणकाम्यया Mk. 3; शापितासि मम लवंगिकावलोकितयोश्व जीवितेन यदि वाचा न कथयसि Māl. 8.

s: puM, (Sapa kroSe + “SINSapiruSamOti .” uRA॰ 3 । 113 । iti aTaH .) anftaM vadan GoraM narakaM yAsyAmi ityevaM rUpaM miTyAniramanam । satyAvaDAraRam । iti sAYJaH । vAcA SarIrasparSanam । iti goyIcandraH ॥ SapaTo divyam । iti ramAnATaH । iti BarataH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । Sapanam 2 । ityamaraH ॥ SapaH 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥ satyam 4 samayaH 5 SApaH 6 pratyayaH 7 aBizaNgaH 8 । iti jawADaraH ॥ * ॥ catuzpAdavyavahArasya kriyApAdANgam । yaTA । aTa SapaTaH । “yuktizvapyavasannAsu SapaTErenamarddayet । arTakAlavalApekzamagnyambusukftAdiBiH ॥” arTasya vivAdAspadasya balaM bahvalpaBAvaH । kAlasya ca balaM puRyApuRyatvam । tadapekzaM yaTA syAdityarTaH । dUrvvAkaratvasya puttrAdisparSasya cAgre darSanIyatvAt । atra mayEtat kftaM na vA iti pratijYAmuccAryyAgnO jale vA hastaM prakzipet । etanmiTyAtve mama sukftaM naSyediti vA brUyAt । na tvagniparIkzAM jalaparIkzAM vA kuryyAt ityaBiprAyavarRanaM yuktam । tasyA mahABiyogavizayakatvena SapaTasamaBivyAhArAnarhatvAt । sukftAdiBirityAdinA dUrvvAsatyAByupagrahaH । taTA ca vizRuH । sarvvezvevArTajAtezu mUlyaM kanakaM prakalpayet । tatra kfzRalone SUdraM dUrvvAkaraM SApayet । dvikfzRalone tilakaram । trikfzRalone jalakaram । catuHkfzRalone svarRakaram । paYcakfzRalone sItodDftamahIkaram । suvarRArdDone kozo deyaH । SUdrasya yaTAsamaye vihitA kriyA taTA dbiguRe'rTe rAjanyasya triguRe'rTe vESyasya caturguRe'rTe brAhmaRasyeti । kfzRalaH kAYcanarattikA tanmUlyAdUne kfzRalone evamanyatra । manuH । “satyena SApayedvipraM kzattriyaM vAhanAyuDEH । gobIjakAYcanErvESyaM SUdraM sarvvEstu pAtakEH । puttradArasya vApyevaM SirAMsi sparSayet pfTak ॥” brAhmaRena mayEtat kftaM na kftaM veti pratijYAmuccAryya satyamiti vaktavyam । taTEva kzattriyeRa vAhanAyuDaM sprazwavyam । taTEva vESyena gobIjakAYcanAnAmanyatamaM sprazwavyam । SUdreRa tu pUrvvoktaM sarvvameva sprazwavyam । tezAM vfTAkftasparSAnAM pAtakahetutvAt pAtakaSabdena nirddeSaH । halAyuDo'pyevam । dEvakriyAvizayamAha nAradaH । “araRye nirjjane rAtrAvantarveSmani sAhase । nyAsApaharaRe cEva divyA samBavati kriyA ॥” bfhaspatiH । “devabrAhmaRapAdAMSca puttradAraSirAMsi ca । ete tu SapaTAH proktA manunA svalpakAraRe । sAhasezvaBiSApe ca divyAni tu viSoDanam ॥” atra SapaTadivyayoH pfTaktvapratIteH SapaTe na divyaDarmmAH । kintu vEDe karmmaRi tatra SOcArTaM snAnAcamanAdi kAryyam । divyAni tu divyatattve kaTitAni nAtra liKitAni । atrABiyuktena SapaTaH karttavya ityutsargaH । uBayecCayA aBiyoktApi । ityAha nAradaH । “aBiyoktA SirovarttI sarvvatrEva prakIrttitaH । icCayAnyataraH kuryyAditaro varttayecCiraH ॥” itaraH SapaTakarttfBinnaH । taTA kAtyAyanaH । “AcaturddaSakAdahno yasya no rAjadEvikam । vyasanaM jAyate GoraM sa jYeyaH SapaTe SuciH ॥” vyasanamApat । DoramatipIqAkaram । taTA ca kozADikAre yasya paSyedityanuvfttO vizRuH । “rogo'gnirjYAtimaraRaM rAjAtaNkamaTApi vA । tamaSudDaM vijAnIyAttaTA SudDaM viparyyayAt ॥” kAtyAyanaH । “tasyEkasya na sarvvasya janasya yadi samBavet । rogo'gnirjYAtimaraRamfRaM dadyAt damaYca saH ॥ jvarAtisAravisPowagUQAsTiparipIqanam । netraruggalarogaSca taTonmAdaH prajAyate ॥ SirorugagudaBaNgaSca dEvikA vyADayo nfRAm ॥” tasyEkasyeti na tu deSavyApakamaraRAdiH । manuH । “na vfTA SapaTaM kuryyAt svalpe'pyarTe naro buDaH । vfTA hi SapaTaM kurvvan pretya ceha ca naSyati ॥ kAminIzu vivAhezu gavAM Bakzye taTenDane । brAhmaRAByupapattO ca SapaTe nAsti pAtakam ॥” kAminIzviti rahasi kAminIsantozArTaM vfTA SapaTaH । evaM vivAhasidDyarTaM gogrAsArTaM AvaSyakahomenDanArTaM brAhmaRarakzArTamaNgIkftaDanAdO । yamaH । “vfTA tu SapaTaM kftvA kIwasya vaDasaMyutam । anftena ca yujyeta vaDena ca taTA naraH । tasmAnna SapaTaM kuryyAnnaro miTyAvaDepsitam ॥” kIwasyeti prARimAtropalakzaRam । tadbaDapApena vfTASapaTakarttA yujyata ityarTaH । iti vyavahAratattvam ॥

a: शपथः — [शप्-अथन्] 1 Cursing. --2 A curse, an imprecation, anathema. --3 An oath, swearing, taking or administering an oath, asseveration by oath or ordeal; आमोदो न हि कस्तूर्याः शपथेनानुभ व्यते Bv. 1. 120; Ms. 8. 109. --4 Conjuration, binding by oaths; Māl. 3. 2. --Comp. --पत्रं an affidavit, a statement on oath.

k.v: विवादो व्यवहारः स्यादुपन्यासस्तु वाङ्मुखम्. उपोद्धात उदाहारः शपनं शपथः पुमान्.।

m: शपथ—जम्भन mf(ई)n. nullifying a curse, Āpast.
शपथ—करण n. swearing or taking an oath, Dhūrtan.
शपथ—पूर्वकम् ind. with oaths, Cat.
शपथ—पत्त्र n. written testimony on oath or affidavit, MW.
शपथ—यावन mf(ई)n. averting a curse, AV.
शपथ—योपन mf(ई)n. warding off or nullifying a curse, ib.
शपथेय्य m. a curser, swearer, AV.
शपथोत्तरम् ind. with oaths, Kathās.
शपथ्य mfn. depending on a curse, (a sin) consisting in cursing or imprecation, RV.
